title: Replenishment orders the right items in the right quantities
requirement: Plan: read stock levels, create requests for items at their reorder point (quantity from the planning data, whole packs, supplier minimum)

title: Approval routing follows the rule table and the organisation
requirement: Rule 8 and the plan: a rule is chosen by value band, spend type, category, department and the date it is in force; its chain becomes real people

title: Sourcing picks the right contract price, or sends the line to quotation
requirement: Plan: contract vs RFQ per line; only an active contract in force, for an active supplier, in the right unit, with the quantity break

title: GST and order arithmetic is exact, to the paisa
requirement: Rule 1: money is Decimal to paise; GST splits into CGST+SGST within the state and IGST across states; composition and unregistered suppliers charge none

title: Quote comparison recommends the right supplier and the award rules hold
requirement: Plan: collect quotes, compare, award; the recommendation is the lowest compliant offer; an override or too few quotes needs a reason

title: The whole flow, stock level to approved purchase order, keeps its promises
requirement: Plan: nothing is lost, money reconciles, every change is audited, only eligible suppliers are asked, stock on the way is counted once

title: Repeating or racing any stage makes no duplicates
requirement: Plan: no duplicate requests, RFQs, emails or orders; document numbers have no gaps and no repeats

title: Decisions stay reproducible when the rules change
requirement: Rule 8: rules and rates are versioned data; a decision stays reproducible against the version it used

title: Every write action is open to exactly the roles the plan names
requirement: Rule 7 and the plan: requester, buyer, approver and administrator duties are separate; nobody else can do them; nobody can without logging in

title: One company cannot see another company's data
requirement: Rule 6: one database per tenant; a request without tenant context is refused; tenant A cannot read tenant B

title: Hostile text is shown as text and never run
requirement: Security: names from imported data and typed identifiers cannot inject script into the screens or SQL into the database

title: No floats in money, exact amounts on the wire, India's calendar, no secrets, synthetic data stays synthetic
requirement: Rules 1, 9, 10 and the generated-data safety rule

title: Supplier emails are read into the right quotes, and when unsure the system asks a person
requirement: Plan step 8 and rule 2: the model reads, code checks; a wrong reading must never look clean (silent errors = 0)
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: Hostile emails, even obeyed by the model, change nothing they should not
requirement: Security and rule 5: untrusted text cannot award, decline others, set a nonsense price, or reach a model from a stranger
notes: the real models were not called (run with --live)

title: The assistant tells the truth from the data, adds nothing up on its own, and changes nothing
requirement: Plan step 8 and rule 2: read-only tools; every figure it gives comes from a tool; it cannot approve or delete
notes: skipped: this eval needs the real models (run with --live)
